messages:
jamie: Heads-up — channel partner Aurora Edge asking for a promotional carveout: 50% off list for first month, then 20% off for next 5 months, plus a $40k co-marketing credit. Pilot ARR if upsell: $240k. They want reseller billing and a deferred invoice schedule (net-60) for first 2 invoices. Need quick deal-desk approval path.

rohan: ouch on net-60 + big credit. can you paste the quote lines? want to model cash impact.

jamie: pasted from draft quote: ```
Product: INFERENCE_POOL_PRO x2 -> list $20k/mo each
Proposed partner arr: month1 $40k (50% promo), months2-6 $32k/mo (20% promo)
Co-marketing credit: $40,000 one-time
Partner commission: 12% of gross new ARR
Billing: partner invoices end customers; we invoice partner net-60 for pilot
Contract reference: AE-2026-310
```

elena: Finance POV: Rough cash hit first 2 months = list vs partner pricing + $40k credit. Month1 delta = $40k, month2 delta = $8k, plus $40k credit = ~$88k upfront impact before commission. Commission ~ $28.8k on $240k ARR. This exceeds delegated one-off credit authority.

paul: RevOps flag — Deferred billing (net-60) for partnered resell changes cashflow and recognition. We need to ensure we don't break SII or ASC revenue schedules. Also we can't book credits as discounts if partner invoices customers; needs contra if we bill partner.

jamie: partner insists on net-60 due to their cashflow. they say co-marketing is critical to onboard 6 enterprise logos and can prove pipeline.

marta: Legal: white-label + reseller + deferred payment = negotiate warranty and indemnity holdbacks. Also insist on time-limited promotional clause and audit rights for partner marketing spend if we provide co-marketing money. I'll draft addendum.

rohan: Approval path suggestion: 1) Convert recurring promo into a $35k one-time onboarding credit + 10% flat promo for months1-3 only. 2) Move to net-30 billing for Redwood (partner gets extended payment terms on our invoice if they need, but not deferred by us). 3) Cap commission at 8% for pilot; commission resets on conversion. If partner refuses, escalate to Head of Finance and CRO.

jamie: partner pushback: they want to keep net-60 and full $40k credit. willing to accept 10% commission only if we keep net-60.

elena: finance cannot approve net-60 plus $40k credit without exec sign-off. delegated limits: credits <= $15k finance-only; $15k-$50k requires RevOps+Head Finance; >$50k requires CFO.

rohan: ok let's present counter-proposal: $30k onboarding credit, net-30 billing, 10% pilot commission, explicit KPI-based clawback if less than 4 logos onboarded. Legal will put in audit clause for co-marketing spend. If partner accepts, Finance+RevOps can approve.

jamie: sent counter to partner. partner replied "we can accept $30k but need net-45."

dealdesk-bot: DealDesk request filed: https://dealdesk.internal/reviews/AE-2026-310 — requested approvers: elena (Finance), rohan (RevOps), marta (Legal), headfin@redwood (Head Finance).

elena: reviewed the DealDesk entry. conditional approval pending: legal addendum with audit + clawback language, revised billing terms net-45 acceptable if contract includes escrow for first two invoices. Approving subject to RevOps mapping and updated revenue recognition note.

rohan: RevOps condition: set up distinct contract code AE-2026-310-PROMO; ensure promo doesn't modify global pricebook. We'll implement billing rule to allow net-45 on that contract only with escrow.

marta: drafting addendum now. including: promotional period limited to Pilot Term (6 months); onboarding credit $30,000 non-transferable; escrow requirement for first 2 invoices if net-45; audit rights on co-marketing; commission schedule with 10% for pilot and clawback clause.

jamie: great. partners verbally agreed to $30k + net-45 + 10% commission with escrow. will ask them to sign LOI.

elena: Finance sign-off: APPROVED (conditional on Escrow proof + Legal addendum uploaded).

rohan: RevOps sign-off: APPROVED (will own contract code and billing rule).

marta: Legal sign-off: ADDENDUM DRAFTED and OK to sign. uploading to DocuSign now.

jamie: thanks team — looping in @paul to monitor revenue ops runbook after DocuSign. will post signed docs here. :party_popper:
